title: SQL Server: utility 1.7 over 1.5 without the flag fails the update

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, utility 1.5 then 1.7, one run

symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_DDL_OBJECTS_MISSING: "DDL objects missing on table ... Execute the DDL objects script and full refresh the table", then PIPELINE_NON_RETRYABLE_ANALYSIS_CLIENT_ERROR.
cause: Not established. Possibly intended for a database set up by 1.5.
fix: Run the DDL objects script the message names, then full refresh the table. With the flag on the change-tracking setup, the rerun passed.
notes: The database had a non-default collation.
